definitions: A large, entirely aquatic salamander (Cryptobranchus alleganiensis) native to eastern North America, known for its flattened body and wrinkled skin.
A person who behaves in a wild, reckless, or immoral way.
examples: The hellbender is a nocturnal predator.
He was a hellbender in his youth, always getting into trouble.
Conservation efforts are in place to protect the hellbender.
